findings.claim: The documented remote Clippy gate does not match the actual GitHub Actions Clippy matrix.
findings.evidence: `dagger/README.md` lists `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -W clippy::pedantic`, while `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs `cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins`, a separate `--features frf-gateway/dev-endpoints` pass, and `cargo clippy --workspace --tests`; constraint T2 requires docs to match code.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the README Clippy command with the exact three-command matrix used by `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, or change CI to match the documented command.

findings.claim: The new dev signal subject behavior is not covered by any added test.
findings.evidence: The diff adds `subject: None` to the constructed `SignalEnvelope` in `dev.rs`, but no test file is added or modified to assert the dev injection envelope subject behavior; constraint T1 says new logic carries unit/integration tests.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a unit or route-level test that exercises the dev inject path and verifies the emitted `SignalEnvelope` includes `subject: None`.
